  | mut_readonly : mut
.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ

  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_box : typ -> typ

  | typ_mut : mut -> typ -> typ

  | typ_int : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_record : atom -> typ -> typ
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp

  | exp_set_box : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : label -> exp

  | exp_record_write: exp -> atom -> exp -> exp
with rec_comp : Set :=


  | rec_empty : rec_comp
  | rec_exp : atom -> exp -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
  | rec_ref : atom -> label -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_box T => typ_box (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_mut M T => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (open_tt_rec K U T1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_te_rec K U b) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_te_rec K U e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_te_rec K U e1) a (open_te_rec K U e2)
  end

  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
  end.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

  | type_var : forall X,

  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=

  | box_in_normal_form : forall T,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_box T)
  | readonly_box_in_normal_form : forall T m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
  | int_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_int T1 T2)
  | record_in_normal_form : forall a T1,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_record a T1)
  | readonly_record_in_normal_form : forall T a m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
.

Inductive in_intersection : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | actually_equal : forall S T,
    S = T ->
    in_intersection S T
  | in_intersection_left : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S L ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R)
  | in_intersection_right : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S R ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R).

Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
    (in_intersection S T).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    end.

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)

  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
      typing_record_comp E R r T ->
      typing E R (exp_record r) T

  | typing_record_read : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) T
  | typing_record_read_readonly : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_record_write : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
      typing E R e1 (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T
with typing_record_comp : env -> sig -> rec_comp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_record_empty : forall E R,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing_record_comp E R rec_empty typ_top
  | typing_record_exp : forall E R a e r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
  | typing_record_ref : forall E R a l r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
.

Notation "E @ R |- e T" := (typing E R e T) (at level 70).

Notation "E @ R |-r r T" := (typing_record_comp E R r T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T e1)
  | value_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_ref l)
  | value_sealed_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_seal (exp_ref l))
  | value_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_record r)
  | value_sealed_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_seal (exp_record r))
with value_record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | value_rec_empty :
      value_record_comp rec_empty
  | value_rec_ref : forall a l r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value_record_comp (rec_ref a l r)
.

Notation store := (LabelMap exp).

Notation empty_store := (LabelMapImpl.empty store).

Definition well_formed_store (s : store) :=
  forall l v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> value v.

(* The original dependent pair uses this same witness. *)
Definition fresh_label_for_store (s : store) :=
  Label.fresh (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)).

Definition typing_store (E: env) (R : sig) (s : store) :=
  forall l,
    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
        exists v,
            (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) /\
            typing E R v T /\ value v)
    /\
    (forall v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
        exists T, (value v /\ typing E R v T /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R)).

Notation "E |-st s @ R" := (typing_store E R s) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_lookup_ref (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) : option label :=
    match r with
    | rec_ref a' l r => if (a === a') then Some l else record_lookup_ref a r
    | _ => None
    end.

Notation "r # a" := (record_lookup_ref a r) (at level 70).

Inductive red : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_app_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s1 (exp_app e1' e2) s1'
  | red_app_2 : forall e1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value e1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s2 (exp_app e1 e2') s2'
  | red_tapp : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' V,
      type V ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_tapp e1 V) s1 (exp_tapp e1' V) s1'
  | red_abs : forall T e1 s1 v2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value v2 ->
      red (exp_app (exp_abs T e1) v2) s1 (open_ee e1 v2) s1
  | red_tabs : forall T1 e1 s1 T2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      red (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) s1 (open_te e1 T2) s1
  | red_let_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let e1 e2) s1 (exp_let e1' e2) s1'
  | red_let : forall v1 e2 s2,
      well_formed_store s2 ->
      value v1 ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let v1 e2) s2 (open_ee e2 v1) s2
  | red_box_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_box e1) s1 (exp_box e1') s1'
  | red_box_ref : forall v1 l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red (exp_box v1) s1 (exp_ref l) (LabelMapImpl.add l v1 s1)
  | red_unbox_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_unbox e1) s1 (exp_unbox e1') s1'
  | red_unbox_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) s1 v1 s1
  | red_unbox_sealed_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_set_box_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_set_box e1 e2) s1 (exp_set_box e1' e2) s1'
  | red_set_box_2 : forall v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_set_box v1 e2) s2 (exp_set_box v1 e2') s2'
  | red_set_box_ref : forall l v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_set_box (exp_ref l) v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
  | red_seal_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_seal e1) s1 (exp_seal e1') s1'
  | red_seal_abs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) s1 (exp_abs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_tabs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) s1 (exp_tabs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_ref: forall l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_ref l)) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_record : forall r s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_record r)) s1
  | red_record : forall r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record r1) s1 (exp_record r1') s1'
  | red_record_read_1 : forall a e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_read e1 a) s1 (exp_record_read e1' a) s1'
  | red_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_record r) a) s1 v1 s1
  | red_sealed_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_seal (exp_record r)) a) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_record_write_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_write e1 a e2) s1 (exp_record_write e1' a e2) s1'
  | red_record_write_2 : forall a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_record_write v1 a e2) s2 (exp_record_write v1 a e2') s2'
  | red_record_write_ref : forall a l r v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_write (exp_record r) a v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
with red_record_comp : rec_comp -> store -> rec_comp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_record_exp_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1,
      record_comp r1 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) s1 (rec_exp a e1' r1) s1'
  | red_record_exp_2 : forall a v r1 s1 l,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      record_comp r1 ->
      value v ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a v r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s1)
  | red_record_ref : forall a l r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_ref a l r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1') s1'
.

Notation "< e1 | s1 > --> < e1' | s1' >" := (red e1 s1 e1' s1') (at level 69).

Notation "< r1 | s1 > -->r < r1' | s1' >" := (red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1') (at level 69).

Inductive redm : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | redm_eq : forall e s e' s',
    e = e' -> s = s' -> redm e s e' s'

(* Opening a locally closed type at any index leaves it unchanged. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_cancel T : forall i j X U,
  i <> j ->
  open_tt_rec i X T = open_tt_rec j U (open_tt_rec i X T) ->
  T = open_tt_rec j U T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros i j X U Hneq H; cbn [open_tt_rec] in *; try reflexivity.
  - destruct (i == n), (j == n); subst; try contradiction; auto.
  - inversion H. f_equal; eauto.
  - inversion H. f_equal; eauto.
  - inversion H. f_equal; eauto.
  - inversion H. f_equal; eauto.
  - inversion H. f_equal; eauto.
  - inversion H. f_equal; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_open_closed T : type T -> forall k U, open_tt_rec k U T = T.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros k U; cbn [open_tt_rec]; try solve [f_equal; auto].
  f_equal; auto.
  fresh_atom X HX L. symmetry. eapply open_tt_rec_cancel with (i:=0) (X:=X).
  - discriminate.
  - symmetry. apply H1; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_ty (X : atom) (P T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_fvar Y => if Y === X then P else T
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (subst_ty X P A) (subst_ty X P B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (subst_ty X P A) (subst_ty X P B)
  | typ_box A => typ_box (subst_ty X P A)
  | typ_mut m A => typ_mut m (subst_ty X P A)
  | typ_int A B => typ_int (subst_ty X P A) (subst_ty X P B)
  | typ_record a A => typ_record a (subst_ty X P A)
  | _ => T
  end.

  match T with
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow A B | typ_all A B | typ_int A B => fv_ty A "'`union` fv_ty B
  | typ_mut _ A | typ_box A | typ_record _ A => fv_ty A
  | _ => {}
  end.

Lemma subst_ty_fresh X P T : X `notin` fv_ty T -> subst_ty X P T = T.
Proof.
  induction T; cbn; intros H; fresh_part; try solve [f_equal; auto].

    subst_ty X P (open_tt_rec i Y T) = open_tt_rec i Y T ->

      try solve [inversion H; f_equal; eauto].
    - exact H. }

  - destruct (X0 === X) as [->|]; auto.
    exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
  - f_equal; eauto.
    fresh_atom Y HY (L `union` {{ X }}).
    eapply Hcancel with (i:=0) (Y:=Y); [fsetdec|].
    apply H1; [auto|]. simpl_env. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_ty_rec X P T : type P -> forall k U,

Proof.

  - destruct (k == n); reflexivity.

Proof.

  (forall Y U, binds Y (bind_sub U) E -> wf_typ F (subst_ty X P Y)) ->

Fixpoint map_exp (var : atom -> exp) (ann : typ -> typ) (e : exp) : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_fvar x => var x
  | exp_abs T b => exp_abs (ann T) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_app f a => exp_app (map_exp var ann f) (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_tabs T b => exp_tabs (ann T) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_tapp f T => exp_tapp (map_exp var ann f) (ann T)
  | exp_let a b => exp_let (map_exp var ann a) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_box a => exp_box (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_unbox a => exp_unbox (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_set_box a b => exp_set_box (map_exp var ann a) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_seal a => exp_seal (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (map_comp var ann r)
  | exp_record_read a l => exp_record_read (map_exp var ann a) l
  | exp_record_write a l b => exp_record_write (map_exp var ann a) l (map_exp var ann b)
  | _ => e
  end
with map_comp (var : atom -> exp) (ann : typ -> typ) (r : rec_comp) : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (map_exp var ann e) (map_comp var ann r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (map_comp var ann r)
  end.

Definition replace_var (x : atom) (v : exp) (y : atom) :=
  if y === x then v else exp_fvar y.
Notation subst_e x v := (map_exp (replace_var x v) (fun T => T)).
Notation subst_r x v := (map_comp (replace_var x v) (fun T => T)).
Notation subst_te X P := (map_exp exp_fvar (subst_ty X P)).
Notation subst_tr X P := (map_comp exp_fvar (subst_ty X P)).

Lemma record_dom_map var ann r : record_dom (map_comp var ann r) = record_dom r.
Proof. induction r; cbn; congruence. Qed.

Fixpoint fv_exp (term : bool) (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_fvar x => if term then {{ x }} else {}
  | exp_abs T b | exp_tabs T b | exp_tapp b T =>
      (if term then {} else fv_ty T) "'`union` fv_exp term b
  | exp_app a b | exp_let a b | exp_set_box a b | exp_record_write a _ b =>
      fv_exp term a `union` fv_exp term b
  | exp_box a | exp_unbox a | exp_seal a | exp_record_read a _ => fv_exp term a
  | exp_record r => fv_comp term r
  | _ => {}
  end
with fv_comp (term : bool) (r : rec_comp) : atoms :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => {}
  | rec_exp _ e r => fv_exp term e `union` fv_comp term r
  | rec_ref _ _ r => fv_comp term r
  end.

Fixpoint map_exp (var : atom -> exp) (ann : typ -> typ) (e : exp) : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_fvar x => var x
  | exp_abs T b => exp_abs (ann T) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_app f a => exp_app (map_exp var ann f) (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_tabs T b => exp_tabs (ann T) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_tapp f T => exp_tapp (map_exp var ann f) (ann T)
  | exp_let a b => exp_let (map_exp var ann a) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_box a => exp_box (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_unbox a => exp_unbox (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_set_box a b => exp_set_box (map_exp var ann a) (map_exp var ann b)
  | exp_seal a => exp_seal (map_exp var ann a)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (map_comp var ann r)
  | exp_record_read a l => exp_record_read (map_exp var ann a) l
  | exp_record_write a l b => exp_record_write (map_exp var ann a) l (map_exp var ann b)
  | _ => e
  end
with map_comp (var : atom -> exp) (ann : typ -> typ) (r : rec_comp) : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (map_exp var ann e) (map_comp var ann r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (map_comp var ann r)
  end.

Definition replace_var (x : atom) (v : exp) (y : atom) :=
  if y === x then v else exp_fvar y.
Notation subst_e x v := (map_exp (replace_var x v) (fun T => T)).
Notation subst_r x v := (map_comp (replace_var x v) (fun T => T)).
Notation subst_te X P := (map_exp exp_fvar (subst_ty X P)).
Notation subst_tr X P := (map_comp exp_fvar (subst_ty X P)).

Lemma record_dom_map var ann r : record_dom (map_comp var ann r) = record_dom r.
Proof. induction r; cbn; congruence. Qed.

Fixpoint fv_exp (term : bool) (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_fvar x => if term then {{ x }} else {}
  | exp_abs T b | exp_tabs T b | exp_tapp b T =>
      (if term then {} else fv_ty T) "'`union` fv_exp term b
  | exp_app a b | exp_let a b | exp_set_box a b | exp_record_write a _ b =>
      fv_exp term a `union` fv_exp term b
  | exp_box a | exp_unbox a | exp_seal a | exp_record_read a _ => fv_exp term a
  | exp_record r => fv_comp term r
  | _ => {}
  end
with fv_comp (term : bool) (r : rec_comp) : atoms :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => {}
  | rec_exp _ e r => fv_exp term e `union` fv_comp term r
  | rec_ref _ _ r => fv_comp term r
  end.

Lemma normal_open_merge T m : forall k P,
  normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec k P (merge_mutability T m)) =
  merge_mutability (normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec k P T)) m.
Proof.
  induction T; intros; try reflexivity.
  - destruct m, m0. symmetry. apply merge_idem.
  - exact (f_equal2 typ_int (IHT1 k P) (IHT2 k P)).
Qed.

Lemma normal_open_normal T : forall k P,
  normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec k P (normal_form_typing T)) =
  normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec k P T).
Proof.
  induction T; intros; try reflexivity.
  - exact (f_equal2 typ_arrow (IHT1 k P) (IHT2 k P)).
  - exact (f_equal2 typ_all (IHT1 k P) (IHT2 (S k) P)).
  - exact (f_equal typ_box (IHT k P)).
  - change (normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec k P (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) m)) =
      merge_mutability (normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec k P T)) m).
    now rewrite normal_open_merge, IHT.
  - exact (f_equal2 typ_int (IHT1 k P) (IHT2 k P)).
  - exact (f_equal (typ_record a) (IHT k P)).
Qed.

(* The data of a runtime form, independently of any uses of subsumption. *)
Inductive runtime_shape :=
  | shape_abs (arg result : typ)
  | shape_tabs (bound body : typ)
  | shape_ref (sealed : bool) (contents : typ)
  | shape_record (sealed : bool) (field : atom -> typ -> Prop).

Definition permits_access E sealed readonly U T :=
  sub E U T /\\ (if readonly then True else sealed = false /\\ sub E T U).

(* Readonly distributes through intersections. It restricts access to boxes
   and record fields, while leaving applications and instantiations available. *)
Fixpoint accepts E (shape : runtime_shape) (readonly : bool) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_fvar _ | typ_bvar _ => False
  | typ_arrow A B =>
      match shape with
      | shape_abs V U => sub E A V /\\ sub E U B
      | _ => False
      end
  | typ_all A B =>
      match shape with
      | shape_tabs V U =>
          sub E A V /\\ (forall P, sub E P A -> sub E (open_tt U P) (open_tt B P))
      | _ => False
      end
  | typ_box A =>
      match shape with
      | shape_ref sealed U => permits_access E sealed readonly U A
      | _ => False
      end
  | typ_record a A =>
      match shape with
      | shape_record sealed field => exists U, field a U /\\ permits_access E sealed readonly U A
      | _ => False
      end
  | typ_int A B => accepts E shape readonly A /\\ accepts E shape readonly B
  | typ_mut _ A => accepts E shape true A
  end.

Lemma accepts_readonly E shape T :
  accepts E shape false T -> accepts E shape true T.
Proof.
  induction T; destruct shape; cbn; unfold permits_access in *; firstorder.
Qed.

Lemma accepts_merge E shape T m ro :
  accepts E shape ro (merge_mutability T m) <-> accepts E shape true T.
Proof.
  induction T; try reflexivity.
  change ((accepts E shape ro (merge_mutability T1 m) /\\
           accepts E shape ro (merge_mutability T2 m)) <->
          (accepts E shape true T1 /\\ accepts E shape true T2)).
  now rewrite IHT1, IHT2.
Qed.

Lemma access_change E sealed ro U A B :
  sub E A B -> sub E B A ->
  permits_access E sealed ro U A -> permits_access E sealed ro U B.
Proof. unfold permits_access. destruct ro; intuition eauto using sub_trans. Qed.

Lemma accepts_normal E T : wf_typ E T -> wf_env E ->
  forall shape ro, accepts E shape ro (normal_form_typing T) <-> accepts E shape ro T.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros HE shape ro; try reflexivity.
  - destruct shape; try reflexivity. cbn [accepts normal_form_typing].
    pose proof (sub_to_normal E T1 HE H).
    pose proof (sub_from_normal E T1 HE H).
    pose proof (sub_to_normal E T2 HE H0).
    pose proof (sub_from_normal E T2 HE H0).
    intuition eauto using sub_trans.
  - destruct shape; try reflexivity.
    change ((sub E (normal_form_typing T1) bound /\\
       (forall P, sub E P (normal_form_typing T1) ->
          sub E (open_tt body P) (open_tt (normal_form_typing T2) P))) <->
      (sub E T1 bound /\\
       (forall P, sub E P T1 -> sub E (open_tt body P) (open_tt T2 P)))).
    pose proof (sub_to_normal E T1 HE H) as Hto.
    pose proof (sub_from_normal E T1 HE H) as Hfrom.
    assert (Hb : forall P, wf_typ E P ->
      sub E (open_tt (normal_form_typing T2) P) (open_tt T2 P) /\\
      sub E (open_tt T2 P) (open_tt (normal_form_typing T2) P)).
    { intros P HP.
      assert (Hraw : wf_typ E (open_tt T2 P)) by eauto using wf_typ_open.
      assert (Hnorm : wf_typ E (open_tt (normal_form_typing T2) P)).
      { assert (Hall : wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)) by eauto.
        apply wf_typ_normal in Hall. inversion Hall; subst.
        eauto using wf_typ_open. }
      assert (Heq : normal_form_typing (open_tt (normal_form_typing T2) P) =
                    normal_form_typing (open_tt T2 P)) by apply normal_open_normal.
      split; eauto using sub_normal_eq. }
    split; intros [Ha Hr]; split; eauto using sub_trans.
    + intros P HP. destruct (sub_regular _ _ _ HP) as [_ [HPwf _]].
      destruct (Hb P HPwf) as [Hback _].
      eauto using sub_trans.
    + intros P HP. destruct (sub_regular _ _ _ HP) as [_ [HPwf _]].
      destruct (Hb P HPwf) as [_ Hforward].
      eauto using sub_trans.
  - destruct shape; try reflexivity.
    cbn [accepts normal_form_typing]. split; eapply access_change;
      eauto using sub_to_normal, sub_from_normal.
  - change (accepts E shape ro (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) mut_readonly) <->
            accepts E shape true T).
    rewrite accepts_merge. auto.
  - change ((accepts E shape ro (normal_form_typing T1) /\\
             accepts E shape ro (normal_form_typing T2)) <->
            (accepts E shape ro T1 /\\ accepts E shape ro T2)).
    now rewrite IHwf_typ1, IHwf_typ2.
  - destruct shape; try reflexivity. cbn [accepts normal_form_typing].
    split; intros [U [Hfield Haccess]]; exists U; split; auto;
      eapply access_change; eauto using sub_to_normal, sub_from_normal.
Qed.

Lemma accepts_sub E S T :
  sub E S T -> forall shape ro, accepts E shape ro S -> accepts E shape ro T.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros shape ro Hshape; cbn [accepts] in *;
    try solve [intuition eauto using accepts_readonly].
  - destruct shape; intuition eauto using sub_trans.
  - destruct shape; try contradiction.
    destruct Hshape as [Ha Hb]. split; eauto using sub_trans.
    intros P HP.
    eapply sub_trans; [apply Hb; eauto using sub_trans|].
    eapply sub_open; eauto.
  - destruct shape; try contradiction. eauto using access_change.
  - destruct shape; [contradiction|contradiction|contradiction|].
    destruct Hshape as [U [Hfield Haccess]].
    exists U. eauto using access_change.
  - destruct shape; [contradiction|contradiction|contradiction|].
    destruct Hshape as [U [Hfield [Hup _]]].
    exists U. unfold permits_access. eauto using sub_trans.
  - destruct (sub_regular _ _ _ H1) as [HE _].
    apply (proj1 (accepts_normal _ _ H0 HE shape ro)).
    apply IHsub. apply (proj2 (accepts_normal _ _ H HE shape ro)); auto.
Qed.
EOF
make"

Definition record_field R r a U :=
  exists l, record_lookup_ref a r = Some l /\\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig U) R.

Lemma record_lookup_fresh r a : a "'`notin` record_dom r -> record_lookup_ref a r = None.
Proof.
  induction r; cbn; auto. intros H. fresh_part.
  destruct (a0 === a) as [->|]; [exfalso; fsetdec|auto].
Qed.

Lemma record_field_tail R a l r :
  a `notin` record_dom r ->
  forall b U, record_field R r b U -> record_field R (rec_ref a l r) b U.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh b U [q [Hlook Hbind]]. exists q. split; auto.
  cbn. destruct (b === a) as [->|]; auto.
  rewrite record_lookup_fresh in Hlook by auto. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma accepts_fields E (fields fields'"' : atom -> typ -> Prop) sealed ro T :
  (forall a U, fields a U -> fields' a U) ->
  accepts E (shape_record sealed fields) ro T ->
  accepts E (shape_record sealed fields') ro T.
Proof.
  induction T in ro |- *; cbn [accepts]; intros; try tauto.
  - eauto.
  - intuition.
  - destruct H0 as [U [HF HU]]. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_value_accepts E R r T :
  typing_record_comp E R r T -> value_record_comp r ->
  accepts E (shape_record false (record_field R r)) false T.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros Hv; inversion Hv; subst; cbn [accepts]; auto.
  split.
  - exists T. split.
    + exists l. cbn. destruct (a === a); congruence.
    + unfold permits_access.
      assert (HR : wf_sig E R) by eauto.
      assert (HT : wf_typ E T) by eauto using wf_sig_bound.
      eauto using wf_typ_sub_refl.
  - eapply accepts_fields; [apply record_field_tail; auto|eauto].
Qed.

Definition seal_shape (shape : runtime_shape) :=
  match shape with
  | shape_ref _ U => shape_ref true U
  | shape_record _ fields => shape_record true fields
  | _ => shape
  end.

Lemma accepts_seal E shape T :
  accepts E shape true T -> accepts E (seal_shape shape) true T.
Proof.
  induction T; destruct shape; cbn [accepts seal_shape]; try tauto.
Qed.

Inductive runtime_form E R : exp -> runtime_shape -> Prop :=
  | form_abs L V e T :
      (forall x : atom, x "'`notin` L -> typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e x) T) ->
      runtime_form E R (exp_abs V e) (shape_abs V T)
  | form_tabs L V e T :

      runtime_form E R (exp_tabs V e) (shape_tabs V T)
  | form_ref l T :
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      runtime_form E R (exp_ref l) (shape_ref false T)
  | form_record r :
      value_record_comp r ->
      runtime_form E R (exp_record r) (shape_record false (record_field R r))
  | form_sealed_ref l T :
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      runtime_form E R (exp_seal (exp_ref l)) (shape_ref true T)
  | form_sealed_record r :
      value_record_comp r ->
      runtime_form E R (exp_seal (exp_record r)) (shape_record true (record_field R r)).
